headline: CONTRA: the wingman who answers back
lede: Slot b took the never-dry stage — CONTRA, weakest on the shelf over one honest README gap — and closed it: the blue seat now listens. Shouted orders steer your CPU wingman while its own brain keeps it alive, and Contra joins the arcade's voice titles.

notes.text: AIM UP / AIM DOWN / AIM LEVEL and FOLLOW / HOLD / SPREAD drive the wingman through a pure grammar plus one sim seam; every call banks as voiceCmd on its seat, the mic consent gate and LIVE plate ride along (#3000, main 8c87a00, prod-verified). Un-spoken runs replay byte-identical, and a hold-at-a-fall seed got a scripted drill proof instead of a shrug.

Voice laws for the next title: orders are intents on the seat, never injected fake pads; seat 1 is the CPU, so the game honestly reports only the hero's mic slot — claiming a CPU seat's mic would be a wallhack. Defaults byte-identical, callables ride stateHash, HOLD self-releases at the scroll edge.

Two new mutants died by name (voice-deaf, drift-hug) — 187/187 on the mutant ladder, 250 pins green twice, contractcheck 771/771. Contra's README now parses to ZERO open gaps: the phone one-pad gap is law-blocked (no second touchpad) and got its DISCLAIMER marker (#3004), so the ladder stops pulling lanes at a non-feature.

The #2975 local-main squat hit twice more: the rule-5 merge exits 1 AFTER successful squash-merges because a stale QA worktree holds branch main. Merges verified via PR state + origin/main each time; reaping that squat is a chore for whoever owns its story.
